steps.title: Bem-vindo: Culture - Volume 40
steps.text: In this C1-level lesson, we'll explore essential vocabulary and phrases about "Culture". Get ready to level up your real-world communication skills!

words.example: There's a real generation gap in how we use technology.
There's a superstition about walking under ladders.
The old town is a protected cultural heritage site.

steps.question: Which sentence correctly demonstrates "Present Continuous"?
options: If I had money, I would buy a car.
If it rains, I will stay home.

steps.title: Idiom: Get out of hand
steps.text: It means: "To become uncontrollable.". Say the example sentence out loud:
steps.targetPhrase: The party got out of hand pretty quickly.
